mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (user_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, content, order_id, is_read, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{orderId}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, sender_type as senderType, sender_id as senderId, msg_type as msgType, content, order_id as orderId, is_read as isRead, create_time as createTime from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} order by id asc limit 500

select m.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, u.username as username, m.msg_type as lastMsgType, m.content as lastContent, m.create_time as lastTime, (select count(1) from chat_message c where c.user_id = m.user_id and c.sender_type = 1 and c.is_read = 0) as unreadCount from chat_message m inner join ( select user_id, max(id) as max_id from chat_message group by user_id ) t on m.id = t.max_id left join user u on u.id = m.user_id order by m.id desc

select id, user_id as userId, sender_type as senderType, sender_id as senderId, msg_type as msgType, content, order_id as orderId, is_read as isRead, create_time as createTime from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 1
select count(1) from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} and sender_type = 2 and is_read = 0
select count(1) from chat_message where sender_type = 1 and is_read = 0
mapper.update: update chat_message set is_read = 1 where user_id = #{userId} and sender_type = 2 and is_read = 0
update chat_message set is_read = 1 where user_id = #{userId} and sender_type = 1 and is_read = 0
update chat_message set is_read = 1 where id = #{id}
